**Issue #2688 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2688: Patch: the AI prices a Unit's “when this attacks” and “after this attacks” effects while it stands on the board
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Some Units do something every time they attack: The Propagation's Wasp makes a copy of itself, Badger and Honey Badger grow, Boots on the Ground and Nature Titan have their own payoffs. The practice AI does see the effect when it plans its own attack this turn, but when it weighs a Unit sitting on the board, its own or the opponent's, it values it as a plain body. So it kills a vanilla 4/4 and leaves the Wasp that doubles next turn, and it trades its own Badger away like a plain body. Once built, the AI counts what a Unit's next attack would give its controller, as it already counts what its start-of-turn or end-of-turn text would give.

## Why
- The hooks are `when_attacks` and `after_attack` (`crates/engine/src/script.rs:1190-1205`). Ten non-token Units carry one (grep `when_attacks: Some|after_attack: Some` under `crates/cards/src/scripts`), among them Boots on the Ground `classic-013`, Nature Titan `classic-045`, Badger `stinkyscape-075`, Honey Badger `stinkyscape-076`, Wasp and Hornet `stinkyscape-091`/`092` and Shield Amplifier `stinkyscape-038`.
- Nothing in `crates/ai/src` reads either hook. `unit_worth` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:333-390`) adds the Activate price (R2564000), Plague Counters, Death (R2424000) and turn hooks (R2477000, R2565000), all probed once at the decision's root and stored in `Prices`.
- The reply's trader picks the opponent's attacks by `kill_worth`, which is `unit_worth` less Death and Reborn (`evaluate.rs:1092-1099`, `crates/ai/src/reply.rs:146-156`, `:209-245`), so an attack hook never changes which body it removes first.
- Honey Badger is on the sweep's at-risk list (`crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs:855`).

## Proposal
- A root probe in the shape of the Activate probe (`probe_turns`, `evaluate.rs:1603-1622`): for each readable Unit on either field with an attack hook, at its controller's next turn on a sandbox copy, declare its attack on the enemy hero where legal (else the first legal target), and the same attack by a twin with the hooks stripped (its printed keywords kept); the controller's evaluation difference is the price, stored in `Prices.attack_hooks`.
- `unit_worth` adds `w.attack_hook * price` inside the Brittle share; a new `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` weight in `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (CLAUDE.md rule 9). The trader and `even_trade` then read it through `kill_worth`.
- Draw probe nodes from the existing death/turn-hook budget or a new named one; nothing hidden is probed (R185).
- A ruling in this issue's block, with `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; re-run `cargo jackioh gate`.

## Where it lands
- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` (where the root probes are gathered)
- Tests: a new `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs` beside `turn_hooks.rs`
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; SPEC §6.2, §9.9

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Facing an enemy Wasp and a vanilla Unit of equal stats with one removal, the AI removes the Wasp.
- [ ] The AI's own Badger is worth more on its board than a vanilla body of the same stats.
- [ ] With a zero `attack_hook` weight the evaluation is what it is today (a test pins it).
- [ ] Tests named after the new ruling, listed in its `proven_in`; `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, clippy, `cargo jackioh gate` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Size and risks
Medium to large, hard (the AI): about 150 lines and tests, the size of #2564. Risk: probe cost per decision; capping the probes by a node budget, as Death's are, keeps the search's budget whole. A hook that only pays on a kill (Prem Panther) prices near zero against the hero, which is acceptable for a first version.

## Plan

_Written by `gpt` (codex, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41323655406)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Teach the AI's root evaluation to price one next attack's `when_attacks` and `after_attack` payoff for every visible Unit on either board. Carry that price through `Prices` into `unit_worth`, `kill_worth`, reply trades, and even-trade ordering, while a zero weight preserves today's evaluation and all probes remain deterministic, information-safe, and node-bounded.

## Files to touch

| Path | Status | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | Document attack-hook prices in the purity, evaluation, and budget contracts. |
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | Add `EvalWeights::attack_hook`, its AI/baseline values, and `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`. |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | Add `AttackHookPrice`, `Prices.attack_hooks`, next-turn twin-attack probes, and the weighted `unit_worth` term. |
| `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` | change | Gather `attack_hook_prices` at the root and include them in `Prices`. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs` | new | Prove R2688000's pricing, choices, zero-weight compatibility, hidden-information safety, and budget. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs` | change | Register the `attack_hooks` test module. |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | Extend §9.9 Evaluation/Budgets with attack-hook pricing. |
| `spec/rulings/R2688000.md` | new | Record the AI-only ruling and list its proving test. |
| `spec/pending/2688.md` | new | Add issue #2688's pending §11 paragraph. |

Do not touch `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `apps/web`, catalog/patch data, generated wire files, `spec/06-keywords.md`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, or forbidden bot/workflow paths. Governing text: SPEC §6.2 (`When this attacks`, `Whenever this attacks`, `After this attacks`) and §9.9, especially R185/R186, R2285000/R2285001/R2396000, R2424000, R2477000/R2565000, and R2564000/R2603000.

## Steps

1. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, add `attack_hook: f64` to `EvalWeights` next to `turn_hook`/`activation`. Set `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` to `0.5` as an untuned root-probe share and `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook` to `0.0` so the frozen baseline stays unchanged. Add `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES: usize = 24`, documented as two turn ends plus the hooked and hookless attack simulations for board Units, and update nearby comments naming all probe budgets.
2. In `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, extend the module/import comments and add `AttackHookPrice { def_id, radiant, controller, price }`, with `key`/`is_for` matching definition, face, and controller. Add `attack_hooks: Vec<AttackHookPrice>` to `Prices`, including `Prices::NONE`, and add `has_attack_hook`/`attack_hook_price`; return zero when the weight is zero, no matching price exists, or the Unit's running face no longer has `when_attacks` or `after_attack`.
3. In `unit_worth`, add `w.attack_hook * attack_hook_price(...)` beside Activate before multiplying by `brittle_share`, so Brittle discounts the future attack and `kill_worth`, `reply::trade_value`, and `candidates::even_trade` inherit it without changes to those modules.
4. In `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, implement `attack_hook_prices(world, seat, counter)`. Exit without nodes for a zero weight, prompt/result, a non-main-phase/non-active-seat root, or no active Unit with either hook. Capture the root-board candidates and keys, clone the root with both `auto_end_turn` flags false, and use the existing `next_turn` helper to reach the enemy's next turn and then the seat's. Following `probe_turns`, price the enemy's candidates first, then the seat's; require the original instance to remain active with the same key/controller on its reached turn. For each Unit, select its attack on `hero-<opponent>` when listed by `legal_actions`, otherwise the first listed `Attack` for that attacker.
5. For each selected attack, run it through `simulate(..., Prices::NONE)` once normally and once on a twin state where the attacker's script is neutralized: copy `face_of(...).keywords` into its granted keywords before setting `vanilla = true`, preserving its tuned printed keywords and existing grants while suppressing `when_attacks`/`after_attack`. Skip a pair if either simulation is cut/refused or leaves a prompt unresolved; otherwise store the controller's `evaluate(..., NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL)` difference, including zero or a harmful negative result, keyed by the root Unit. Deduplicate matching keys and draw all turn ends, attacks, and automatic answers from a sub-counter capped at `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`.
6. In `crates/ai/src/decide.rs::plan`, call `attack_hook_prices(&probe, seat, counter)` with the other root probes before building `Prices`, and populate its new `attack_hooks` field. Update the root-probe comment/ruling list.
7. Add `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, using the scenario/support patterns in `turn_hooks.rs` and `activations.rs`, and register it in `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs`.
8. Update `crates/ai/README.md` and SPEC §9.9's Evaluation/Budgets paragraphs to say the root advances to each controller's next turn, attacks the enemy hero or first legal target with hooked and hookless keyword-preserving twins, prices their controller-evaluation difference, adds `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` inside Brittle, never probes hidden/off-board cards, and charges the named cap from the decision budget.
9. Add `spec/rulings/R2688000.md` with `id`, title, nonempty `cards` references, `proven_in: crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, counted/not-counted cases, budget/information rules, and rejected alternatives: a flat hook premium, probing the current/spent turn, probing hidden/off-board cards, sharing another probe's cap, and changing engine/card scripts. Add the matching dated paragraph to `spec/pending/2688.md`; do not edit the folded index or §11 file.

## Tests

In `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, add R2688000-named tests:

- `r2688000_a_wasp_is_worth_more_to_remove_than_an_equal_vanilla`: an enemy Propagation's Wasp and vanilla 3/3 receive one Hit Job; assert the priced `kill_worth` and `decide` target the Wasp in both field orders/cursors.
- `r2688000_an_own_badger_is_worth_more_than_an_equal_vanilla`: assert the next hero attack gains a Resource, gives a positive price, and lifts the own Badger's `unit_worth` above a vanilla 2/3.
- `r2688000_a_zero_weight_is_the_old_evaluation`: copy `AI_EVAL`, set `attack_hook = 0.0`, pass nonempty attack prices, and assert `unit_worth`/evaluation equal `Prices::NONE`; also assert `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook == 0.0`.
- `r2688000_the_twin_keeps_printed_keywords`: use Tmack Trav attacking an armored hero, where Pierce changes combat but its after-attack hook pays nothing without a kill, and assert its hook price is zero rather than body/Pierce damage.
- `r2688000_a_taunt_uses_the_first_legal_target`: bar the hero with Taunt and assert Badger is still positively priced from attacking the first legal Unit.
- `r2688000_hidden_cards_change_no_price_or_decision`: vary only same-cost definitions in the opponent's hidden hand/face-down Trap; build each probe with `redact`, `det_ground`, and `determinize_on` using the same probe RNG, then assert identical prices and `decide` action/line.
- `r2688000_a_board_without_attack_hooks_spends_no_node` and `r2688000_the_probes_and_decision_stay_within_their_budgets`: pin the fast path, `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`, and total `AI_BUDGET`.

Run exactly:

1. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r2688000`
2. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai attack_hooks`
3. `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`
4. `cargo fmt --check`
5. `cargo jackioh catalog check`
6. `cargo jackioh patches check`
7. `cargo jackioh spec check`

Do not run the whole workspace tests/clippy, fuzz, gate, full Vitest, or e2e suites in this shared-machine run.

## Done when

- [ ] Enemy Wasp removal and own Badger preservation/value satisfy the acceptance cases.
- [ ] Zero `attack_hook` weight exactly preserves the prior evaluation.
- [ ] Printed keywords, first-legal fallback targeting, hidden information, determinism, and node caps are proved.
- [ ] R2688000 exists, every proving test name contains `r2688000`, `proven_in` matches, and pending §11 prose is present.
- [ ] The focused AI tests, AI clippy, rustfmt, catalog, patches, and spec checks pass.
- [ ] The diff contains only the nine listed files plus `.bot-plan.md` (ignored), with no card/gameplay, generated-wire, index, or forbidden-path changes.

## Risks

- The hookless twin must not erase printed/tuned keywords such as Rush, Cleave, or Pierce, or body combat leaks into the hook price; preserve them as grants before Vanilla suppresses scripts.
- Advancing turns can fire unrelated public turn effects, kill/transform the candidate, open prompts, or end the game. Run both twins from the same reached state, require the original root instance/key still applies, and skip unresolved/refused pairs rather than guess.
- Attack simulations can consume RNG or trigger traps. Both twins start from clones with the same seed/cursor, use the real reducer and `Prices::NONE`, and all work consumes the bounded shared counter.
- Never enumerate hands, libraries, Dormant/buried cards, or face-down backrow; start from `active_units_of` on the already redacted/determinized probe world, preserving R185.
- A copied/fused Unit can combine attack hooks with other text that Vanilla suppresses in the twin. Keep the first version explicitly scoped to the requested hook delta and document this approximation/rejection in R2688000; do not modify engine script registries or card scripts to manufacture a hook-only override.

## Open questions

None. The accepted proposal fixes the target policy, one-attack horizon, weight location, root-only lifetime, hidden-information boundary, and bounded-probe design; use R2688000, the first free number in issue #2688's block.
```

# Plan (gpt-5.6-sol, medium)

## Goal

Teach the AI's root evaluation to price one next attack's `when_attacks` and `after_attack` payoff for every visible Unit on either board. Carry that price through `Prices` into `unit_worth`, `kill_worth`, reply trades, and even-trade ordering, while a zero weight preserves today's evaluation and all probes remain deterministic, information-safe, and node-bounded.

## Files to touch

| Path | Status | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | Document attack-hook prices in the purity, evaluation, and budget contracts. |
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | Add `EvalWeights::attack_hook`, its AI/baseline values, and `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`. |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | Add `AttackHookPrice`, `Prices.attack_hooks`, next-turn twin-attack probes, and the weighted `unit_worth` term. |
| `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` | change | Gather `attack_hook_prices` at the root and include them in `Prices`. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs` | new | Prove R2688000's pricing, choices, zero-weight compatibility, hidden-information safety, and budget. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs` | change | Register the `attack_hooks` test module. |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | Extend §9.9 Evaluation/Budgets with attack-hook pricing. |
| `spec/rulings/R2688000.md` | new | Record the AI-only ruling and list its proving test. |
| `spec/pending/2688.md` | new | Add issue #2688's pending §11 paragraph. |

Do not touch `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `apps/web`, catalog/patch data, generated wire files, `spec/06-keywords.md`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, or forbidden bot/workflow paths. Governing text: SPEC §6.2 (`When this attacks`, `Whenever this attacks`, `After this attacks`) and §9.9, especially R185/R186, R2285000/R2285001/R2396000, R2424000, R2477000/R2565000, and R2564000/R2603000.

## Steps

1. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, add `attack_hook: f64` to `EvalWeights` next to `turn_hook`/`activation`. Set `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` to `0.5` as an untuned root-probe share and `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook` to `0.0` so the frozen baseline stays unchanged. Add `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES: usize = 24`, documented as two turn ends plus the hooked and hookless attack simulations for board Units, and update nearby comments naming all probe budgets.
2. In `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, extend the module/import comments and add `AttackHookPrice { def_id, radiant, controller, price }`, with `key`/`is_for` matching definition, face, and controller. Add `attack_hooks: Vec<AttackHookPrice>` to `Prices`, including `Prices::NONE`, and add `has_attack_hook`/`attack_hook_price`; return zero when the weight is zero, no matching price exists, or the Unit's running face no longer has `when_attacks` or `after_attack`.
3. In `unit_worth`, add `w.attack_hook * attack_hook_price(...)` beside Activate before multiplying by `brittle_share`, so Brittle discounts the future attack and `kill_worth`, `reply::trade_value`, and `candidates::even_trade` inherit it without changes to those modules.
4. In `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, implement `attack_hook_prices(world, seat, counter)`. Exit without nodes for a zero weight, prompt/result, a non-main-phase/non-active-seat root, or no active Unit with either hook. Capture the root-board candidates and keys, clone the root with both `auto_end_turn` flags false, and use the existing `next_turn` helper to reach the enemy's next turn and then the seat's. Following `probe_turns`, price the enemy's candidates first, then the seat's; require the original instance to remain active with the same key/controller on its reached turn. For each Unit, select its attack on `hero-<opponent>` when listed by `legal_actions`, otherwise the first listed `Attack` for that attacker.
5. For each selected attack, run it through `simulate(..., Prices::NONE)` once normally and once on a twin state where the attacker's script is neutralized: copy `face_of(...).keywords` into its granted keywords before setting `vanilla = true`, preserving its tuned printed keywords and existing grants while suppressing `when_attacks`/`after_attack`. Skip a pair if either simulation is cut/refused or leaves a prompt unresolved; otherwise store the controller's `evaluate(..., NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL)` difference, including zero or a harmful negative result, keyed by the root Unit. Deduplicate matching keys and draw all turn ends, attacks, and automatic answers from a sub-counter capped at `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`.
6. In `crates/ai/src/decide.rs::plan`, call `attack_hook_prices(&probe, seat, counter)` with the other root probes before building `Prices`, and populate its new `attack_hooks` field. Update the root-probe comment/ruling list.
7. Add `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, using the scenario/support patterns in `turn_hooks.rs` and `activations.rs`, and register it in `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs`.
8. Update `crates/ai/README.md` and SPEC §9.9's Evaluation/Budgets paragraphs to say the root advances to each controller's next turn, attacks the enemy hero or first legal target with hooked and hookless keyword-preserving twins, prices their controller-evaluation difference, adds `AI_EVAL.attack_hook` inside Brittle, never probes hidden/off-board cards, and charges the named cap from the decision budget.
9. Add `spec/rulings/R2688000.md` with `id`, title, nonempty `cards` references, `proven_in: crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, counted/not-counted cases, budget/information rules, and rejected alternatives: a flat hook premium, probing the current/spent turn, probing hidden/off-board cards, sharing another probe's cap, and changing engine/card scripts. Add the matching dated paragraph to `spec/pending/2688.md`; do not edit the folded index or §11 file.

## Tests

In `crates/ai/tests/ai/attack_hooks.rs`, add R2688000-named tests:

- `r2688000_a_wasp_is_worth_more_to_remove_than_an_equal_vanilla`: an enemy Propagation's Wasp and vanilla 3/3 receive one Hit Job; assert the priced `kill_worth` and `decide` target the Wasp in both field orders/cursors.
- `r2688000_an_own_badger_is_worth_more_than_an_equal_vanilla`: assert the next hero attack gains a Resource, gives a positive price, and lifts the own Badger's `unit_worth` above a vanilla 2/3.
- `r2688000_a_zero_weight_is_the_old_evaluation`: copy `AI_EVAL`, set `attack_hook = 0.0`, pass nonempty attack prices, and assert `unit_worth`/evaluation equal `Prices::NONE`; also assert `GREEDY_EVAL.attack_hook == 0.0`.
- `r2688000_the_twin_keeps_printed_keywords`: use Tmack Trav attacking an armored hero, where Pierce changes combat but its after-attack hook pays nothing without a kill, and assert its hook price is zero rather than body/Pierce damage.
- `r2688000_a_taunt_uses_the_first_legal_target`: bar the hero with Taunt and assert Badger is still positively priced from attacking the first legal Unit.
- `r2688000_hidden_cards_change_no_price_or_decision`: vary only same-cost definitions in the opponent's hidden hand/face-down Trap; build each probe with `redact`, `det_ground`, and `determinize_on` using the same probe RNG, then assert identical prices and `decide` action/line.
- `r2688000_a_board_without_attack_hooks_spends_no_node` and `r2688000_the_probes_and_decision_stay_within_their_budgets`: pin the fast path, `AI_ATTACK_HOOK_PROBE_NODES`, and total `AI_BUDGET`.

Run exactly:

1. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r2688000`
2. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai attack_hooks`
3. `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`
4. `cargo fmt --check`
5. `cargo jackioh catalog check`
6. `cargo jackioh patches check`
7. `cargo jackioh spec check`

Do not run the whole workspace tests/clippy, fuzz, gate, full Vitest, or e2e suites in this shared-machine run.

## Done when

- [ ] Enemy Wasp removal and own Badger preservation/value satisfy the acceptance cases.
- [ ] Zero `attack_hook` weight exactly preserves the prior evaluation.
- [ ] Printed keywords, first
